title: GEOPIETRA
subtitle: AI CRM
description:
Digitizing the sales ecosystem through custom infrastructure.
A bespoke operational platform developed for Geopietra, centered on a custom CRM managing the full sales lifecycle from lead generation to deal closure while organizing the sales network by territory.
The system includes a real-time quote generator connected to the raw materials database and an AI agent supporting onboarding, internal workflows, and team communication.
